_comment: Cross-language pin for the detector camera layouts named by PerceptionStats.camera_set (protocol 11). Not a wire message: streetlab-backend/tests/test_detector_cameras.py and streetlab/tests/detectorCameras.test.ts both assert their own tables against this ONE file, so the renderer's cameras and the backend's model of them cannot drift. yaw_deg is relative to the ego heading (+ = left); all cameras share the mount position and downtilt (contract/mount_pitch_rad.json). Each camera is one inference per frame time.
